FortressTV 2.0.0-RC17

Trakt.tv Features:
- Two-Way Watched History Sync: Import watched movies and TV series episodes directly from Trakt with fast local catalog matching.
- Manual Watched/Unwatched Toggle Sync: Marking movies or episodes watched or unwatched in FortressTV updates your Trakt watch history in real time.
- Trakt Watchlist: Dedicated customizable Home screen shelf featuring items from your Trakt Watchlist matched against your active VOD sources.
- Series Episodes auto-match: Opening series episodes automatically correlates season and episode progress against Trakt history.
- Trakt Sync Controls: Dedicated Watchlist and Watched History manual sync triggers and status reporting in Settings.
- Full English and Portuguese (pt-PT) localization.
